events.title: The Jury Experience – Death by AI: Will New York Make Justice?
events.description:
⭐  Bring your crew into an immersive courtroom and put your judgement to the test.  Hear the testimonies, weigh the evidence, and see if you can  sway the room  as you  search for the truth.  
 
🫣 Moral Dilemma #1: A driverless car. A life lost. Who pays the price, the programmer, the passenger, or the machine itself?  

  Highlights  
🧑‍⚖️ An  immersive theatre show  that places you at the center of the courtroom. 
🤩A chance to engage with the foundation of our justice system:  seeking truth with integrity  
🫵  Vote during key moments.  Your decisions shape hidden angles in the case,  making every show different!  
🧠 Take part in a  live social experiment  where your choices shape the outcome 
💬 The kind of show that naturally leads to  post-verdict debates  with your friends. 
🎁 Gift memories to someone special! Purchase a gift card for  The Jury Experience   
 
 General Info  
📅 Dates and times: select your date & time directly in the ticket selector 
📍 Location: Irondale 
⏳ Duration: 60 minutes 
👤 Age requirement: 12+. Children under the age of 16 must be accompanied by an adult 
♿ Accessibility: the venue is ADA compliant 
🗣️ Language: English 
📱 Bring your phone to scan QR codes and participate in key moments of the show 
❓ Please consult the FAQs of this experience  here  

  Description  
A driverless car has taken a life, and someone must be held accountable. In this experience, you become part of a  live investigation  that blends technology, morality, and human judgment. Through testimonies, evidence, and real-time voting, you’ll confront the question at the center of modern justice: Who is truly responsible when AI makes a fatal mistake? 
 
This isn’t just a theatrical show, it’s a  challenge to your reasoning , your instinct for fairness, and how your judgment shapes your own version of the truth. Every detail matters. Every perspective counts. And once the verdict is cast, most guests naturally end up debating the case.  Everyone sees the truth differently.  
 
Can you stand by your decision? 
Can you change someone else’s mind? 
Can a crowd ever agree on what’s fair? 
 
Get your tickets now for  The Jury Experience – Death by AI: Will New York Make Justice?  and take part in a night where  your voice truly shapes the outcome.  
 
 Script, Staging, and Creative Direction: Agustina Videla and Pablo Destito

Drunk Romeo & Juliet
events.description:
⭐  Experience Shakespeare like never before at Drunk Romeo & Juliet, a wild and hilarious twist on the classic tragedy where one tipsy Romeo meets one very sober cast — and the chaos unfolds live on stage!  

  Highlights  
🎭 A bold, comedic take on Shakespeare’s iconic love story 
🥃 One actor plays Romeo... after a few shots of whiskey 
🤣 Every show is unique, unscripted, and hilariously unpredictable 
🎉 A night of theater, improv, and laugh-out-loud surprises 
💘 Perfect for date night, group hangs, or fans of chaotic comedy 
  
 
🎁 Gift memories to someone special! Purchase a gift card for Drunk Romeo & Juliet  here  

  General Info  
📅 Date and time: Choose in the ticket selector 
⏰ Duration: 90 minutes 
📍 Location: 35 W 39th St, New York, NY 10018 
🔞 Age Requirement: 21+ with valid ID 
🍸 Bar available on site 

  Description  
Drunk Romeo & Juliet flips the script on traditional theater, fusing classic Shakespeare with comedy, improv, and just the right amount of whiskey. In this one-of-a-kind show, one brave actor gets progressively drunk while playing Romeo, and the rest of the sober cast scrambles to keep the story of star-crossed lovers from going completely off the rails. Expect unexpected line deliveries, impromptu dance breaks, and Shakespearean drama like you’ve never seen before. If you love live entertainment with a twist, this is your new favorite plan in NYC.
